# Potjielek-Lekker

> Interactive Indoor Tabletop Mini Potjie Setups & Individual Dining Experiences.

## Overview

Potjielek-Lekker provides complete tabletop mini potjie setups designed for functions, dinner parties, and special events. Each guest receives their own cast-iron pot, burner stand, and protective board directly at the dining table, creating an interactive dining experience where everyone can cook their own custom meal right in front of them.

## Key Features & Product Packages

- Complete Tabletop Setups: All-in-one individual mini potjie kits (pot, stand, burner cup, wooden board) designed safely for indoor dining tables.
- Interactive Dining Concept: Perfect for functions, family gatherings, and corporate events where guests are active participants in cooking their personalized dishes.
- Table Protection: The custom stands and included under-boards are engineered to protect your dining table.
- Direct Orders & Booking: Inquiries, package options, and orders are handled directly via WhatsApp integration for fast local service.
